review.notes: Full word-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 31 physical PDF pages (case/punctuation/hyphen-insensitive) plus a per-page numeric diff; physical pages 1, 7, 9, 16 and 17 were rendered at 115 dpi to verify every patch. No code fences exist in the source, so no fence-balance damage. All four numbered footnote markers survive while the footnote bodies (URLs) were dropped; restored after the paragraphs carrying their markers. The title-page corresponding-authors and copyright footer was dropped and restored. In the contributors section the printed "Nvidia Partners" group label was dropped, leaving its five members visually attached to the preceding "Hugging Face Partners" group. Reference [112] prints the author name "ShafieiBavani" without a space; OCR split it into "Shafiei Bavani". Numbers flagged missing on physical pages 2 and 5 are demo-screenshot tokens (<loc0255>) and chart axis ticks inside the embedded Figures 2 and 4 (not defects); 2412.03555 is the rotated arXiv sidebar stamp, dropped per project convention. All 112 reference entries are present; the print's own misspellings ("model sizes an input resolutions", "on the on the MIMIC-CXR data") are preserved.
